origin.description: Remove whitespace from the start, the end, or both.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: side
arguments.text: Which side to trim: "both" (the default), "left", or "right". The whole word is required.

origin.details: Whitespace is the stringi trim class, including newlines, tabs, and non-breaking spaces. The default side is both.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.
origin.example:
print(str_trim("  String with trailing and leading white space	"))
print(str_trim("

String with trailing and leading white space

"))
